units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 1:1:30">Y. Ber. I, 2ᵈ</cite> bot., a. fr. <he>פ׳ לה וכ׳</he> there is an explanation for it (you can meet this difficulty by saying), that it refers &c.
<cite ref="Tamid 32a:18">Tam. 32ᵃ</cite> <he>מילתא דא אין לה פ׳</he> this problem is insolvable.
<cite ref="Yevamot 97b:4">Yeb. 97ᵇ</cite> [read with Ar.] <he>נישל לכו סתר פ׳</he> we shall ask you something too mysterious for solution.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shevuot 1:1:3">Y. Shebu. I, 32ᶜ</cite> sq. <he>פתר לה פ׳ חורן</he> offered a different solution for it.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Demai 7:8:3">Y. Dem. VII, end, 26ᶜ</cite> <he>אין לך אלא כהדין פי׳ קדמיא</he> there is nothing left to thee but to agree with the first interpretation.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nazir 5:1:7">Y. Naz. V, 53ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>כפִתְרֵה דר׳ ירמיה</he> as R. J. has explained it; a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="Q02207"><he>פִּתְרִין</he></cite>, <he>פִּתְרַיָּיא</he>, <he>פִּתְרַיָּיה</he>, <cite ref="Q00061"><he>פִּי׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin 4:9:2">Y. Erub. IV, end, 22ᵃ</cite> <he>פתר לה תרין פ׳</he> offered two explanations.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 4:2:8">Y. Peah IV, 18ᵇ</cite> top <he>פתר לה כאילין פ׳</he> he explained it in accordance with those explanations (given above); <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Gittin 8:3:7">Y. Gitt. VIII, 49ᶜ</cite> top <he>פתרייתא</he> (corr. acc.).
